decisive_items: nodular proliferations of thick collagen fibers in large fascicles
homogeneous, brightly eosinophilic collagen bundles in haphazard array
response.rationale: Scleromyxedema is the most likely diagnosis due to the combination of clinical and histopathological findings, including firm, red-brown plaques, nodular collagen fiber proliferation, and homogeneous, brightly eosinophilic collagen bundles, which are consistent with this condition.

rejected.why: Morphea is less likely due to the lack of skin tightening in the affected areas, which is a typical feature of this condition.
